cluster_name: India Cockroach Janta Party protests force Education Minister Pradhan resignation
event_summary: India's Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) youth movement protesting the NEET exam paper leak held 36 days of demonstrations at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi; police clashes on July 20 injured at least 180 people, and Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned on July 25.
tldr: Pradhan's full resignation was the movement's hardest non-negotiable demand, and its delivery on day 36 marks a concrete concession from the Modi government that 19 outlets across 13 countries treated as a significant political rupture rather than a routine reshuffle. The Cockroach name originated with a single university student's rhetorical question and was reclaimed as a mass identity, a framing origin covered by international outlets (El Pais, AFP) but absent from official government messaging. Police use of pellet guns documented by BBC video and Dainik Bhaskar's named account of a 19-year-old facing permanent blindness shifted the secondary frame from education scandal to state violence against youth. Two demands remain outstanding: punishment of officers who used pellet guns, and a personal apology from Prime Minister Modi.

silences.what_they_covered_instead: No Chinese-feed articles appear in this cluster. Chinese state media regularly covers Indian political instability as geopolitically relevant, making the absence from a story of this scale editorially notable.
Bangladesh, whose own Gen Z-led student protests toppled Sheikh Hasina in 2024, is entirely absent from the cluster despite the structural parallel the movement invites.

single_outlet_findings.finding: Exclusively reports that Pradhan framed his resignation as protection against anti-national forces exploiting the protests, a BJP security narrative absent from every other outlet covering the same resignation.
Only outlet to report police blocked 400+ social media accounts for fake news during the protests, with an explicit parallel drawn to similar blocks during Operation Sindoor.
Names injured student Sahil Lochab (19, Najafgarh, southwest Delhi): right eye destroyed by pellet gun on July 20; doctors give 1% chance of sight recovery; surgery at AIIMS Apex Trauma Centre.

Only outlet to evaluate the political utility of the hunger-strike tactic in historical context, framing Wangchuk's fast within the Gandhi-era civil disobedience lineage while raising questions about concrete gains.
Provides the only concrete injury count in the cluster: at least 180 people injured in New Delhi protests on July 20.
Only Western European outlet to explain the Cockroach name's satirical origin as a rhetorical question from one university student, contextualizing how the label became collective identity.
Characterizes the government posture as seeking time on the minister resignation demand, the only outlet to frame the government negotiating stance as delay-seeking rather than offer-making.
Sole outlet to report a protester's direct testimony that additional grievances are coming to light beyond the original exam-leak demand, suggesting the protest scope is widening.

bottom_line: Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation on July 25, the CJP's core non-negotiable demand, marks a concrete concession from the Modi government during one of India's largest youth-led protests in recent years, but outstanding demands for police accountability over pellet-gun injuries and a Prime Minister's apology mean the movement has not concluded. The 13-country, 19-outlet footprint spanning Pakistan, Kenya, Spain, Turkey, and both Hindi and English press confirms this has become an internationally watched test of democratic responsiveness in Modi's India.
